kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app. store/apps/Photriya.json:30 primary_category PHOTO_AND_VIDEO; `grep -rn kidsAgeBand store/ratings` -> 0 hits; no KIDS category. store/ratings/Photriya.json has no kidsAgeBand. Spec user is a designer or maker (Photriya.md:60).

banner.where: lib/features/swatchbook/swatchbook_screen.dart:280-286 (one banner at the foot of the Swatchbook list)

interstitial.why: AglAds.onTransition() runs once, when the user comes back to the Swatchbook after a photo session they finished (lib/features/swatchbook/swatchbook_screen.dart:54-58). That is a natural break after a completed task, not mid-task. agl_ads skips the first 2 transitions and caps at 1 per 3 minutes (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ads.dart:22,26). It is a creative tool, not a health or finance one.

native.why: The only long list is the Swatchbook (SliverList.builder at swatchbook_screen.dart:269-279), which holds the user's own captured colours. Designers compare those colours side by side, and a native ad with its own imagery between swatches would get in the way of that work. It is a personal library rather than a content feed. I am unsure whether the founder's 'history' example covers it, so I chose no.

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota or premium tier now: grep for premium/quota/unlock in lib/ finds nothing. All 5 export formats (ASE/GPL/CSS/JSON/PNG, lib/core/color/palette_export.dart:37) are free, and gating one would remove a feature.
